title: Reach-NFT
tagline: Creating NFT's from a creators perspective.
description: This project is quite simple. Create a  multi-chain platform for creators to create their own and distribute their NFT Art. I wanted to create a platform where creators/artists, possibly not adverse to blockchain technology will be could have a platform to sell and connect with the audience.
how_its_made: This project uses Reach Lang for deploying the smart contract and handling the consensus. Reach Lang is a multi-chain dApp programming language and deploys smart contracts out of the box to Ethereum EVM and Algorand Blockchains. For the front end I used a mix of React.JS and HTM5 and CSS3
